fight.gml: run_new(); global.run.sector = 2; combat_begin("bandits", false, false); return true;

end_it_shaking.gml: var cb = global.cb; cb.shake = 8; cb.over = "win"; cb.over_t = 0; return cb.shake;

pause_shaking.gml: var cb = global.cb; cb.over = ""; cb.paused = true; cb.shake = 8; return cb.shake;

live_shake_still_decays.gml: var cb = global.cb; cb.over = ""; cb.paused = false; cb.shake = 8; return cb.shake;
